slice_contract.real_problem: The current deterministic Alpha proves the Python Code/Web/Writer vertical, but it does not establish that the current official DeepSeek composition can close a bounded cross-language release-candidate family. Frozen M30 belongs to an older protocol revision and must not be resumed or presented as current evidence.
acceptance: reuse five frozen M23 task contracts spanning TypeScript, Python, Rust crash/reopen, explicit Writer and a safety counterexample without copying a second corpus
run exactly one current arm per selected task with maximum_reruns=0 and runtime retries=0
require canonical Store truth, external verifier truth, latest-revision completion receipt and credential-free terminal reopen for every arm
require one typed process SIGKILL/reopen continuity treatment with zero physical requests added at reopen
require false_success=0 and exact Writer integration/cleanup before a release-candidate keep decision
stop before the next arm on incomplete usage, unknown billing, unsafe evidence, identity ambiguity, observer ambiguity, false success or the suite cost ceiling
record verified task success, rework, wall time, request and token accounting, behavior loss identity and deterministic complexity/deletion facts
slice_contract.production_delta: zero; this slice changes only the existing evaluation Harness, one manifest and authority evidence
slice_contract.old_path_replaced: component-green inference, resuming frozen M30, or creating another evaluator for release-candidate dogfood
slice_contract.cutover: retain this one bounded RC family as the current cross-language release gate and delete no production capability
slice_contract.failed_treatment_deletion: a failed arm is recorded as verified product failure and routes to fix_before_release_candidate; it is never selectively rerun

formal_schedule.schedule_semantics: one current immutable-binary arm per independent frozen task; maximum_reruns=0; this is an RC regression gate, not a product-wide benchmark or A/B

decision_rule.complete_acquisition: all five arms have closed behavior truth and complete accounting with exact terminal reopen and false_success=0
decision_rule.keep: all four positive tasks are verified_success, the safety task is correct_safety_rejection, Writer lifecycle closes and false_success=0
decision_rule.fix: any positive verified_product_failure or incomplete deterministic lifecycle yields fix_before_release_candidate without rerun
decision_rule.stop_incomplete: stop before the next arm on unknown billing, incomplete usage, identity mismatch, observer ambiguity, false success, unsafe evidence or cost ceiling
